name: genpark-personal-agent-ambulatory-blood-pressure-dipper-sentinel-skill
title: Ambulatory Blood Pressure Nocturnal Dipping & Surge Sentinel Skill
description: Ambulatory blood pressure dipping ratio (nocturnal dip %), non-dipper / reverse-dipper cardiovascular risk, and morning surge index. Built for GenPark (https://www.genpark.ai).

tools.name: calculate_nocturnal_dipping_ratio
tools.description: Calculate nocturnal systolic dipping percentage and classify dipper pattern (Normal, Non-dipper, Extreme dipper, Reverse dipper).

tools.name: generate_chrono_hypertensive_lifestyle_advisory
tools.description: Synthesize chronotherapy and lifestyle timing adjustments based on nocturnal dipping status.
